svg.title: Responses read from their poles
svg.desc: The shaft's angle swings to a first peak of 1.460 radians at 1.62 seconds and then once every 3.24 seconds, each swing 0.212 of the one before, close to the pole prediction. The water stays at 36 degrees Celsius for the 1 second delay and then cools as the pole minus 0.2 per second predicts, 35.368 degrees after 6 seconds.
svg.text: Responses read from their poles: the shaft and the heater
Control Studio recording of this project · shaft under P control, Kp = 4 N·m/rad · numbers answer the predictions
Each swing 0.212 of the one before (poles: 0.197)
